about: Mechanical fabric classes a lingerie block may name (lingerie.fabric). Visual appearance stays in wardrobe/lingerie/fabrics.py and the material plan; this file is behaviour only. Every value carries its status: 'measured' (a cited test on a named fabric), 'designer-convention' (a cited pattern-maker's allowance), 'class-typical' (this project's estimate for the class), or 'unmeasured' (null, with how to measure it). Nothing here is certified to ISO or ASTM. See docs/research/LINGERIE_FABRIC_PHYSICS.md.

patternStretchCourse.note: Uma's xStretch default: the negative ease its designer drafts a stretch-knit brief with. Not a fabric test result.

patternStretchWale.note: Uma's yStretch default: the negative ease its designer drafts a stretch-knit brief with. Not a fabric test result.

arealDensity.calibrate: Weigh a die-cut 100 cm2 specimen conditioned at 20 C / 65% RH (the usual textile method); report g/m2.

thickness.calibrate: Compression thickness gauge at a stated pressure (textiles use about 1 kPa); report mm.

stretchCourse.calibrate: Extension across the courses (or weft) at a stated load, as for low-power knits (ASTM D2594 class of test); report the fraction at that load.

stretchWale.calibrate: The same along the wales (or warp).

recovery.calibrate: Residual growth after the stretch hold and a timed relaxation (the same test family); report 1 - growth.

shearStiffness.calibrate: Bias extension or picture-frame shear test; report the initial slope.

bendingStiffness.calibrate: Cantilever bending length (fabric drape test); convert with the areal density.

friction.calibrate: Sled on a skin simulant at a stated normal load; report kinetic coefficient.
